newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia noon rubber higher on lower supply talk.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia noon rubber higher on lower supply talk.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark SIR20 offer prices were higher at midday trading on Friday on market talk of lower supply due to rains and expected sustained foreign buying, dealers said.
Dealers said Singapore-based dealers were heard buying SIR20 October deliveries fob Medan at 56.50 cents/lb late on Thursday against the previous 56.25 cents.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for October/November deliveries rose 0.25 cents/lb to 56.50-57.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and 56.50-56.75 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 56.00-56.50 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
"It's been raining in Medan in the last couple of days. It is likely to continue in the coming days," one dealer in Medan said.
Dealers said likely lower supply in Thailand due to rains also prompted sellers to raise their offer prices.
There are no fresh latex deals heard. High amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,325-2,350 rupiah/kg in Bandung and Tangerang against the previous 2,425 rupiah/kg, dealers said.
